name: Akhlaq: Quran & Prayer
shortDescription: Prayer times, Qibla and Quran in Arabic, English and Urdu. Read and listen.
fullDescription:
Akhlaq brings Quran reading, prayer times and daily reflection together in a calm, simple app.

READ AND LISTEN
Read the complete Quran in Arabic with English or Urdu translation. Choose Arabic followed by the translation, verse by verse, or listen in one language. Save verses, search the whole Quran and resume your reading. Focus reading hides extra controls. Use the compact player or expand it to move within the current recording. Background playback works with Android media controls. Download recordings for offline listening when connected.

PRAYER AND QIBLA
Calculate prayer times on your device using optional location access or manually entered coordinates. Choose your calculation method and Asr convention, and adjust times to match your local mosque. Enable optional prayer reminders or a short, attributed spoken adhan. A sensor-assisted Qibla compass shows reading quality and can give a brief buzz when reliable readings align.

DAILY PRACTICE
See a daily verse, log prayers, count dhikr and keep private reflections. Explore Quranic duas, six traditional kalimat learning cards, the five pillars and an estimated Hijri calendar with cited readings. Export prayer, dhikr and reflection records in a practice backup. Saved verses, hadiths and calendar notes are not included in that backup.

LEARN WITH SOURCES
Browse 1,018 HadeethEnc narrations carrying the publisher's sahih grade and Bukhari or agreed-upon attribution, in Arabic, English and Urdu. Read publisher explanations and open source links. This is a selection, not a complete Sahih al-Bukhari edition. Eight brief Prophet story summaries link to their Quran passages. Listen to these original English summaries using an installed offline device voice.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Arabic, English and Urdu Quran text, the hadith collection, stories and prayer calculations are bundled for offline reading. No account, ads or analytics SDK. Practice records and coordinates stay on your device. Streaming and audio downloads contact the selected recording provider, which receives your IP address and requested recording URL. Downloads may use mobile data.

SOURCES AND LIMITS
Arabic Quran text: Tanzil Project. English translation: Rowwad Translation Center via QuranEnc. Urdu translation: Muhammad Ibrahim Junagarhi via QuranEnc. Arabic recitation: Mishary Rashid Alafasy via Islamic Network. English audio: QuranEnc. Urdu audio: Shamshad Ali Khan via EveryAyah; its wording can differ from the displayed Urdu translation. Hadith text and grades: HadeethEnc. Source notices and correction links are available in the app. No source publisher endorses Akhlaq.

The interface and story summaries are in English. Text size can be increased to 200%. Check calculated prayer times against your local mosque; methods can differ. Compass accuracy depends on sensors and surroundings. Hijri dates are estimates and can differ from local moon sightings. Background playback and reminders depend on Android permissions and battery settings; force-stopping the app can stop them.
releaseNotes: Clearer backup and calendar export results. Recovery when Android closes the app view. Improved release checks, offline Android testing and refreshed store materials.
